worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.summary: Drive the body forward with psychic force and bite down: it hurts the target, shatters the Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil around the bite, and swallows each shattered layer for extra power. The longest-reaching and heaviest bite of the family.
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.use.0: Bite a target from a step further out
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.use.1: Swallow a barrier as extra force
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.use.2: Eat the screen the moment it goes up
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.descripti: The bite deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block bite radius; the target's Defence, type matchup and criticals are settled on impact.
Lunge %1$s blocks; Reflect, Light Screen and Aurora Veil within %2$s blocks of the bite shatter together, and each shattered layer raises this bite's power by %3$s (up to three layers).
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.devour.on: Devour mode: 1.7x per-layer bonus, 1.25x shatter radius and 1.1x lunge distance, at 0.9x base bite, +2 ticks windup and +8 ticks cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.devour.of: Pierce mode: 1.08x base bite and a quicker breath, but a 0.6x per-layer bonus and the base shatter radius.
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.growth.0: From level %1$s the bite rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.growth.1: From level %1$s the bite rises to %2$s and the devour bonus to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.preferenc: On: 1.7x per-shattered-layer bonus, 1.25x shatter radius and 1.1x lunge distance, but 0.9x base bite, +2 ticks windup and +8 ticks cooldown. Off: 1.08x base bite and a 0.6x per-layer bonus.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of lunging. Larger values open the bite from further out.
On: prefer a target carrying Reflect, Light Screen or Aurora Veil and swallow the barrier for extra force. Off: rank by threat and distance only.
worldcombat.skill.psychicfangs.descripti: The lunge sweeps a narrow corridor, and every enemy along it takes one bite; even when it bites empty air, barriers at the landing point are still shattered.
